# Public Domain Test Scores

These sheet music PDFs are bundled for the `occ sheetmusic:seed-test-library` command so the test library contains real engraved multi-page sheet music instead of blank placeholder PDFs.

All scores are **Public Domain** (both the musical compositions and the LilyPond engravings) and sourced from the [Mutopia Project](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/):

| File | Title | Composer | Pages | License | Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `bach-prelude-c-major-bwv846.pdf` | Prelude in C Major, BWV 846 | Johann Sebastian Bach | 2 | Public Domain | https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV846/wtk1-prelude1/ |
| `beethoven-fur-elise-woo59.pdf` | Für Elise, WoO 59 | Ludwig van Beethoven | 3 | Public Domain | https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BeethovenLv/WoO59/fur_Elise_WoO59/ |
| `joplin-the-entertainer.pdf` | The Entertainer | Scott Joplin | 4 | Public Domain | https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/JoplinS/entertainer/ |
| `mozart-rondo-alla-turca-kv331.pdf` | Rondo Alla Turca, K. 331 | Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart | 5 | Public Domain | https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/MozartWA/KV331/KV331_3_RondoAllaTurca/ |
| `satie-gymnopedie-no1.pdf` | Gymnopédie No. 1 | Erik Satie | 2 | Public Domain | https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/SatieE/gymnopedie_1/ |
